about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established company operating in the automotive industry in Gżira, for a motivated and customer-focused Customer Experience Assistant to join their team.

You will support the Customer Experience Manager in delivering excellent customer service: calling customers after their appointments to gather feedback, following up on concerns and enquiries with the relevant departments, recording complaints in the CRM system and preparing monthly feedback insights for the Sales and Aftersales departments.

The role suits a customer service professional with at least 2 years of experience who communicates well in both English and Maltese. It is a full-time, on-site position with a competitive salary, health insurance and training opportunities.
responsibilities: Contact customers following their appointments to gather feedback on the services provided
Follow up on customer concerns, requests and enquiries with the relevant departments
Record and manage customer complaints in the CRM system, ensuring timely follow-up and resolution
Prepare and submit customer feedback reports and share monthly insights with the Sales and Aftersales departments
Assist the Customer Experience Manager in achieving customer satisfaction targets
Provide information and guidance to customers regarding loyalty programmes and related enquiries
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, feedback and complaints
Work closely with internal departments to ensure a positive customer experience
Participate in training sessions and continuously develop customer service skills
Perform additional duties as assigned by management
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of experience in a customer service role
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Maltese
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM systems
Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
Good problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
Empathetic, adaptable and professional approach when dealing with customers
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
offer: Full-time position with a well-established automotive company
company: Our client is a well-established company operating in the automotive industry, based in Gżira, Malta.
location_text: Gżira is a harbourside town on Malta's north-east coast, between Sliema and Ta' Xbiex, facing Manoel Island and Valletta across Marsamxett Harbour, with frequent bus connections across the island.
howto: Passionate about delivering excellent customer service? Apply online today through Outreach Recruitment — complete the short form on this page and our team will be in touch. We aim to respond to all applications within 3–5 business days.
faq: What does the Customer Experience Assistant job pay?
The salary is competitive and is discussed with shortlisted candidates. Benefits include health insurance, a loyalty card and training and development opportunities.
Do I need to speak Maltese?
Yes. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Maltese are required.
How much experience do I need?
A minimum of 2 years of experience in a customer service role, together with an A-level standard of education.
What does a typical day involve?

Calling customers after their appointments for feedback, following up enquiries and complaints with the relevant departments, logging cases in the CRM system and helping the Customer Experience Manager reach satisfaction targets.
Is this role remote or on-site?
The role is full-time and on-site in Gżira, Malta.
